sub: lieutenant on the Hồi Lan road, he counts the cups. He has seen Tất Dạ Lang's horse at the hall's back gate twice, long after the man deserted to Dạ Quang, and told no one but his file; he does not know Viên Cô Yên (vien_co_yen) let it in. He keeps a file on every head of the hall and would hand it to the Pavilion the day it paid.
